title: Adoption Rate of Outcome-based Contracting for Public Sector Security Service Buyers
what_it_is: Adoption Rate of Outcome-based Contracting for Public Sector Security Service Buyers

sections.label: Outcome-based contracting strategy
sections.summary: Outcome-based contracting is a key strategy under the Security Industry Transformation Map.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: Outcome-based contracting (OBC) is a key strategy under the Security Industry Transformation Map.

sections.label: OBC adoption rates
sections.summary: OBC was made mandatory for new public agency security services contracts from May 2020, with over half adopting it, while private sector adoption was about 6%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: To catalyse the adoption of OBC, it has been made mandatory for public agencies to adopt OBC for new security services contracts put out for tender from May 2020 onwards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: More than half of the public agencies have since adopted OBC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: In a survey conducted by MHA in 2020, the OBC adoption rate among private sector buyers at that time was about 6%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: At the same time, in the survey, about seven in 10 indicated they had plans to adopt OBC.

sections.label: CPS OBC outreach efforts
sections.summary: The Centre for Protective Security has conducted webinars and focus group discussions, launched an OBC resource portal, and disseminated a resource kit to MCST councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: For instance, the Singapore Police Force's Centre for Protective Security (CPS) has been conducting webinars and focus group discussions to share the benefits of OBC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: CPS has also recently launched an OBC resource portal, with useful information on grants, courses and contract templates for premises owners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: For private residences, a resource kit featuring curated cases of successful adoption of OBC has been disseminated to all the MCST councils.
